about: (v361-D) one sentence, one answer — DabtEngine.decide called on its own (Murib._decide) no longer reads the words of the previous sentence (_orig24 and the other per-call fields start from the fresh page's state and are given back); the four last ⚠ rows of Ibn ʿAqīl's ledger (Determ361: A897.1 عطف بيان on a built vocative's place, A897.2 عطف بيان after «ṣifa with أل + its muḍāf ilayh», A903.1 the fāʾ clause joined to the ṣila, A927.1 the badal of an interrogative wearing the hamza) and two hand-overs (a detached pronoun is never «جواب الطلب»; a two-word sentence «زَيْدٌ الْأَفْضَلُ»: khabar, not naʿt). Over every story token (scratchpad determ361/dump.js, 90,147 tokens, read in story order in one page) before → after: 0 lines changed. The first after-run changed 1 (talkhis-al-miftah:67:10:7 بِاللهِ read as «عطف بيان على العامري» — the lexicon's propn for بالله was the name with the bāʾ fused on); the name test now asks that the lemma IS the word, and the re-run changed 0. No new contradiction to judge.
